part: Lower wishbones (suspension arms NHA402) of the Carten T410R with the hinge pins NHA423: front arm and rear arm. Stock parts, not part of the speedrun design, not verified, work in progress. Modelled for the completeness of the build (assembly of the speedrun chassis). Files: cad/stock_parts/wishbone, generated with scripts/cad/generate_wishbones.py from this parameter file.
coordinate_system: Arm coordinates: x across the car, from the axis of the inner hinge pin (x = 0) toward the wheel; y along the inner hinge pin, y = 0 middle of the arm; z = 0 axis of the inner hinge pin, z upward. On the car, the left arm is the right arm turned by 180 degrees about z (same part). Hinge pin: along y, centred at y = 0.
design: Manual step 7 and parts list NHA402 'Arms (F/R)': 2 front arms and 2 rear arms, each part used on the left and on the right side (turned by 180 degrees). Flat frame with a flat bottom face: two inner lugs (ears) on the inner hinge pin NHA423 3x42 between the pivot blocks, an inner bar, two side rails, a floor with X-shaped ribs, a cross bar and two outer lugs for the outer hinge pin of the C-hub (front) or of the hub carrier (rear), with an open space between the cross bar and the outer lugs (front: long open loop; rear: short U). Beside each inner lug a boss with a thread M4 for the droop screw NHA430 M4x10 (one is used). On one side rail a block with holes M3 for the ball stud of the shock (set screw M3x8 with ball NBA210, manual step 7); on the other side rail holes M3 for the ball stud of the sway bar drop link (front 2 holes, rear 1 hole, manual step 7 'Front L/R' and 'Rear L/R'). The holes of the ball studs go through, so that the ball stud can be set from the side that faces the shock tower. Simplified: no radii, no draft, no ribs below the floor; the pivot balls NBA211 at the ends of the hinge pin, the ball studs and the droop screw are not modelled.

source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual: part numbers, sizes of the screws and pins, layout of the arms in step 7 and in the parts list (no dimensions)
source_codes.derived: Calculated from other parts of the model (pivot blocks, bulkheads, chassis plate) or from other values
source_codes.estimate: Estimate from the specification of the car (track width), not measured
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model

open_points: All dimensions marked 'assumption' or 'estimate' are to be measured with a caliper; the letter in 'measure' names the measurement in the drawing photos/cad_wishbones_drawing.png. The model is horizontal (inner and outer hinge pin at the same height); the ride height and the travel of the suspension are not modelled.

inner_pin_d.note: Diameter of the inner hinge pin NHA423 3x42 (manual step 7) and of the bores of the inner lugs.

inner_pin_length.note: Length of the inner hinge pin NHA423. Its ends sit in the pivot balls NBA211 in the blind bores of the pivot blocks (bottoms of the bores 42.68 apart at End A and 42.85 at End B along the pin).

inner_width.note: Length of the arm along the inner hinge pin, over the outer faces of the inner lugs: the gap between the faces of the two pivot blocks is 33.28 (End A) and 33.45 (End B), minus 0.14 and 0.22 play on each side.

inner_lug_len.note: Length of each inner lug along the hinge pin.

inner_lug_d.note: Outer diameter of the inner lugs. At most 6.5: the side face of the lower bulkhead is at x = 17.24, the hinge pin of End A at x = 20.7 (3.46 apart). With 6.0: clearance 0.46.

pin_above_bottom.note: Height of the axis of the inner hinge pin above the flat bottom face of the arm (assumed: bottom face at the bottom of the inner lugs).

rail_top.note: Height of the top of the side rails and of the inner bar above the axis of the inner hinge pin (total height of the frame: D + E).

rail_w.note: Width of the side rails (in the plan view, across the rail).

floor_t.note: Thickness of the floor between the side rails (above the bottom face).

rib_top.note: Height of the X-shaped ribs above the axis of the inner hinge pin (lower than the rails).

inner_bar_x.note: Inner bar between the inner lugs: from x to x (the lugs reach to x = C / 2).

droop_x.note: Distance of the axes of the droop screw bosses from the axis of the inner hinge pin.

droop_y.note: Distance of the axes of the droop screw bosses from the middle of the arm (along the hinge pin).

droop_boss_d.note: Outer diameter of the droop screw bosses (full height of the frame).

droop_tap_d.note: Thread M4 for the droop screw NHA430 M4x10 (manual step 7): tap drill 3.3, through.

arm_length.note: Distance from the axis of the inner hinge pin to the axis of the outer hinge pin. Estimate: track width 190 (spec_cartent410r.yaml), wheel width 30 (spec_tires.yaml), outer hinge pin approx. 15 inside the middle plane of the wheel: 95 - 15 - 15 - 20.7 = 44.3. Measure: outer edges of both pins minus one pin diameter.

outer_pin_d.note: Diameter of the outer hinge pin (C-hub NHA403, hub carrier NHA404) and of the bores of the outer lugs.

outer_lug_d.note: Outer diameter of the outer lugs.

outer_lug_len.note: Length of each outer lug along the outer hinge pin.

outer_pin_z.note: Height of the axis of the outer hinge pin above the axis of the inner hinge pin (arm horizontal).

ball_tap_d.note: Holes of the ball studs (set screw M3x8 with ball NBA210, manual step 7): thread M3, tap drill 2.5, through.

front_outer_gap.note: Front arm: gap between the two outer lugs (width of the C-hub NHA403 at its hinge pin).

front_cross_x.note: Front arm: cross bar at the inner end of the open loop (from x to x); the loop is open from the cross bar to the outer lugs.

front_shock_block.note: Front arm: block for the ball stud of the shock on the side rail at y < 0: from x, to x, top above the axis of the inner hinge pin.

front_shock_holes.note: Front arm: holes for the ball stud of the shock (x, z), along y through the block (manual: 3 holes).

front_sway_holes.note: Front arm: holes for the ball stud of the sway bar drop link (x, z), along y through the side rail at y > 0 (manual step 7 'Front L/R': 2 holes).

rear_outer_gap.note: Rear arm: gap between the two outer lugs (width of the hub carrier NHA404 at its hinge pin).

rear_cross_x.note: Rear arm: cross bar at the inner end of the U between the outer lugs (from x to x).

rear_shock_block.note: Rear arm: block for the ball stud of the shock on the side rail at y < 0: from x, to x, top above the axis of the inner hinge pin.

rear_shock_holes.note: Rear arm: holes for the ball stud of the shock (x, z), along y through the block.

rear_sway_holes.note: Rear arm: hole for the ball stud of the sway bar drop link (x, z), along y through the side rail at y > 0 (manual step 7 'Rear L/R': 1 hole).
